text:
Sam: hi! first week here — trying to open the model-serving Grafana but I get a 403. url is https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/uf8y-model-serving. who usually grants access?
Priya: welcome Sam!!! :tada: are you signing in via Okta or using a service token?
Sam: okta (sam@redwood.com). chrome shows I'm logged in but Grafana redirects to 403.
onboard-bot: Welcome to Redwood! Please complete the Observability access form so infra can provision dashboards: https://go/redwood/obs-access.
Priya: two quick bits: 1) Okta can be provisioned but group-to-team mapping might be missing, 2) some dashboards are restricted to the "infra-observers" Grafana team. Fill the obs-access form and paste the ticket link here.
Sam: just submitted request #7890 — listed Grafana: model-serving, infra-latency; Datadog: model-prod, staging; Sentry: model-service-prod.
Luca: tagging eng-observability @Priya — I can sync the Grafana team mappings. Sam I can try adding you to the infra-observers group now, but if the SSO app hasn't provisioned you yet you'll still hit 403.
Priya: Luca — FYI we've been tightening dashboard edit perms. Sam, we give Viewer + Comment by default. If you need to tweak panels we'll ask dashboard owners to approve edits or you can fork.
Luca: ok I ran the sync and added Sam to grafana-team:infra-observers. Give it a minute and then hard-refresh (ctrl+shift+R) or try incognito.
Sam: tried incognito and still 403. any logs I can capture?
Luca: if you open devtools and check network for the graphql request to /api/dashboards/uid/* you'll see the 403 payload. paste the error id here if present.
Sam: payload shows "errorId: graf-3f2b1" and message "user not authorized for dashboard".
Priya: that means the team mapping didn't apply to that dashboard's folder. I'll flag to the dashboard owner. Who's owner of model-serving (uid uf8y)?
Luca: owner is @maria (team: model-platform). Maria's out today but I can temporarily bind Sam to the dashboard folder with a folder-level viewer role for 24h. Sam ok with that?
Sam: yes please. also Datadog access is still blocked; I can't see monitors. should I open a separate ticket?
Priya: no need, the obs-access ticket covers all three. include a note if you need staging vs prod. For Datadog, we usually add folks to the "model-readers" org role.
Luca: granted folder-viewer to Sam for uid uf8y — try again.
Sam: success! can see panels now. huge help, thank you.
Priya: awesome. before you poke alerts, use the staging Datadog workspace and the test alert channel: #alerts-staging. I'll add you to that channel and to Datadog staging org.
Sam: thanks — one last Q: where's the canonical list of dashboards for new hires?
Priya: see https://go/redwood/observability-dashboards — there's a "new-hire" section with required read access. if anything is missing, open a dashboard request via the obs form.
Sam: perfect, thanks everyone :dino: welcome to the team vibes appreciated.
Priya: welcome aboard :wave: ping if anything regresses and we'll escalate.
thread_text_short: New hire Sam hits 403 on Grafana. Priya and Luca troubleshoot SSO/group mapping, Luca temporarily grants folder viewer; obs-access ticket covers Datadog/Sentry too.
